university_name: Norwegian Universities and Colleges Admission Service (Samordna opptak)
requirement_text: Students from countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland/EFTA must pay tuition fees in Norway.
source_authority_note: samordnaopptak.no is the Norwegian national admissions operator (NUCAS), which coordinates admission to all Norwegian universities and state university colleges. Norwegian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs the APPLICATION_SYSTEM_DOMAINS tier, piece (B) -- HIGH for platform-wide deadlines and access rules, not authoritative for programme-specific thresholds.
limitations: CORRECTS A WIDELY HELD PREMISE. Norwegian public universities are frequently described -- including in this lane's own commissioning brief -- as tuition-free for everyone. That has not been true since the autumn 2023 intake. The national operator states the fee liability plainly, and UiO and NTNU both publish specific amounts (see their records).
researcher_notes: Recorded first and prominently because the false version of this fact is the kind that propagates: it was true for decades, it is repeated in secondary sources, and a student who believes it will not budget for a six-figure NOK bill. Norway now looks structurally like Sweden and Finland on fees, not like the outlier it used to be.

limitations: The GSU-list itself was not fetched in this pass, so the per-country thresholds it contains are NOT recorded here. Only the fact that a central, country-scoped recognition instrument exists and governs eligibility is evidenced.
researcher_notes: GSU expands to 'Generell studiekompetanse for utenlandske sokere' (Higher Education Entrance Qualification for foreign applicants). Flagging this because an AI search summary in this session glossed GSU as 'Guarantee of Financial Support' -- confidently and wrongly. The fetched page shows it under general entry requirements, not funding. A clean illustration of why summaries are leads and fetches are evidence.

requirement_text: TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language) with a minimum score of 60 points on TOEFL iBT / TOEFL iBT Home Edition or 500 points on TOEFL PBT (paperbased test). Tests taken after January 21 2026: TOEFL iBT / TOEFL iBT Home Edition with a minimum score of 3,5 points.
source_authority_note: samordnaopptak.no is the Norwegian national admissions operator (NUCAS), which coordinates admission to all Norwegian universities and state university colleges. Norwegian national domain; fails looksOfficial(). Needs the APPLICATION_SYSTEM_DOMAINS tier, piece (B) -- HIGH for platform-wide deadlines and access rules, not authoritative for programme-specific thresholds.
limitations: '3,5' uses a comma decimal separator (Norwegian convention) and means 3.5 on the 1-6 scale. A parser reading it as an integer or as a thousands separator gets 3500 or 35. Worth naming because the numeral is the whole requirement.
researcher_notes: Second national operator after Sweden to handle the ETS rescale with an explicit date and no orphaned subtest rule. Both Nordic national operators got this right; the institutions in the same countries did not uniformly.

limitations: 5.0 is the floor for the general entrance qualification into NORWEGIAN-taught programmes, not an English-taught programme requirement. Presenting it as 'Norway needs IELTS 5.0' would be badly misleading -- NTNU's and UiO's English-taught programmes set their own, much higher, requirements.
researcher_notes: Scope is doing all the work here. The same page's Norwegian-language requirement (Bergenstesten and successors) is the binding one for these programmes.
